{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.67), forecast prices 1-2% above current levels to correct initial lag",
    "When sentiment is negative (≤0.33), forecast prices 1-2% below current levels to avoid overshooting lows",
    "Mean-reversion: pull forecast toward historical mean when deviation exceeds 2% over 3+ days",
    "Sentiment strength modulation: attenuate forecast changes when sentiment score is near 0.5 (mixed/conflicted)",
    "Lag correction: align early-term forecast points (first 7 days) 0.3-0.5% closer to current price to reduce initial divergence",
    "When sentiment flips sharply (change ≥0.33 in 1 day), add 0.2-0.3% velocity adjustment to first forecast point matching the direction",
    "Avoid oscillating forecasts: when two consecutive 1-day-ahead points show 0.1+ reversal, take the stronger of the two" ]
}
